{{Top}}
[[File:Sandtroopers-SWFB.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sandtroopers on the sands of the Dune Sea]]
{{Quote|Let me see your identifications.|A sandtrooper in Mos Eisley|audio=LetMeSeeYourID.flac|<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Desert stormtroopers''', also referred to as '''Desert Terrain Stormtroopers''' or simply '''sandtroopers''', were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] equipped with modified armor and equipment to withstand the harsh climates of desert [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Equipment==
{{Quote|I wouldn't have thought stormtroopers would know enough about Tatooine to handle the heat, but they didn't seem bothered in the least.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Dewback_btm.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A sandtrooper [[Dewback trooper/Legends|astride]] a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] mount on Tatooine]]
They were nearly identical to standard stormtroopers, but had additional training in specialized areas and advanced cooling systems in both their helmets and suits that offered them protection from the relentless heat. They also were designed specifically to take into account elements in desert worlds that can clog breathing filters and jam machinery, such as [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]], ash storms, or other particles.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> Visual differences in armor included a distinctive diamond-shaped left knee plate, non-ribbed chest and back plate connectors as well as reinforced abdominal plating. It was typical for non-commissioned officers (white and orange pauldrons) and above to remove the "drop boxes" on the waist; a redundant and unnecessary accessory given the upgraded load-bearing kit requirements for sustained operations with minimal resupply. Additionally, the usual thermal detonator worn by normal Stormtroopers on the lower back was not present, as its wear and access would be impeded by the typical [[SD-48 survival backpack/Legends|SD-48 survival backpack]]. The SD-48s were necessary for them to complete extended missions in unrelenting heat, and contains several liters of purified water, a miniaturized vaporator for condensing water from the atmosphere, a long-range comlink, and a collapsible reflective shelter.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

[[File:Local_Garrison_SWDA.png|thumb|right|250px|Sandtrooper wielding a T-21 repeating blaster]]
Their armor consisted of an 18-piece anti-[[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cocoon shell like that of a stormtrooper, but also had a heat-reflective coating worn over a temperature-control body glove, as well as cooling recirculators.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> The sandtrooper helmet featured automatic polarized lenses, a built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and breathing filters. The purpose behind the polarized lenses was to eliminate dune glare.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

All desert sandtroopers carried [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifles]], [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blasters]], or [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifles]], long-range comlinks, food, and water packs. Sandtroopers wore colored [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] as a designation of rank. A sandtrooper [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant's]] pauldron was white, while an enlisted trooper's pauldron was all black. [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] leaders, who led units of seven troopers, wore orange shoulder pauldrons.

==History==
{{Quote|Stop that ship! Blast 'em!|[[Mod Terrik]]|audio=StopThatShipBlastEm.flac|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
[[File:Stormtrooper_Search.png|thumb|left|250px|Sandtroopers searching for [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
The [[Desert Sands|stormtrooper detachment]] dispatched in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] to investigate a crashed escape pod on Tatooine just prior to the Battle of Yavin consisted of sandtroopers. [[Davin Felth/Legends|One of them]] noticed a droid part and concluded that there were droids aboard the escape pod. They eventually encountered Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, and Obi-Wan Kenobi and attempted to stop the departure of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], although they ultimately failed.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Skywalker, when reading up on the sandtroopers upon procuring a copy of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] field manual ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', admitted that he was surprised that the sandtroopers were not bothered at all by the heat on Tatooine, as he expected they would not know enough about the planet to handle it. Solo, likewise, joked that they need to have an "anti-boredom trooper" for places like Tatooine due to boredom being what kills a person rather than the heat itself.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

They had heavy weapons, survival gear, and shoulder pauldrons denoting rank.

Sandtroopers, along with representatives from every specialized [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], were assigned to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] a contingent of sandtroopers were deployed from the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] to capture the [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]], ''[[Killik Twilight]]''.
